notes.title: Pre-Release Demo - The Backrooms: Rescue Expedition
notes.notes:
We're launching the demo for The Backrooms: Rescue Expedition for one month only!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259913/976ae6c0f0d9e3dccfc1318952f9eafaf163979a.png"]



Choose one of the available roles with your friends and venture into the depths of the Backrooms to rescue the lost team.







What's included:



Online cooperative multiplayer.



Two atmospheric levels.



Proximity voice chat.







The demo will only be available for a limited time, so don't miss your chance to be part of the expedition!
